title: Juniper and the Gravity
author: Astrid Fairweather
blurb: Elodie Reyes, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
